![Photo of Thai Luu](assets/avatar.jpg){.about-avatar} I'm Thai Luu, and I'm learning SLAM with 3D Gaussian Splatting. This blog is where I write up what I learn, one question at a time.

I came to the field from classical state estimation (Kalman and particle filters, poses on Lie groups, LiDAR-inertial odometry), so the rendering side is newer to me than the estimation side.

## What I'm learning

The goal is to understand each part of a Gaussian-splatting SLAM system well enough to rebuild it:

- **Rendering:** how volume rendering becomes the alpha blending that 3DGS uses.
- **3D Gaussian Splatting:** the representation, how each Gaussian projects onto the image, and the rasterizer with its gradients.
- **Tracking:** estimating the camera pose by optimizing through the rasterizer.
- **Mapping:** adding, pruning and managing Gaussians as the map grows.
- **Geometry:** getting depth and surfaces right, not only the rendered images.
- **Global consistency:** pose graphs and loop closure.

Later I'd like to move on to other sensors and dynamic scenes. I study on demand: a course or a paper gets my time when the part I'm working on needs it, so the posts will not follow this list in order. Alongside the reading I rebuild the parts in code, starting with a minimal rasterizer in plain PyTorch checked against [gsplat](https://github.com/nerfstudio-project/gsplat). The courses and the people behind them are listed on the [Thanks](thanks.qmd) page.

## How posts work

Each post asks one question and puts it through the test I use to decide whether I understand something:

1. Derive the answer on paper.
2. Re-implement it and match a reference implementation, with the numbers shown.
3. Say what is still open.

Posts stick to textbook material and published methods. To follow new ones, add `https://zerokhong1.github.io/blog/index.xml` to a feed reader such as Feedly or Inoreader.

## What this blog is, and isn't

This blog does not sell courses, teach business or give advice. It is a learning notebook: I write to understand things properly and to keep getting better, and in the hope of meeting people who care about the same problems. If you are learning these topics too, I would be glad to hear from you, by email at <thailuucong.hust@gmail.com> or on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/congthaineur/).

These are notes from someone still learning, so expect mistakes. If you find one, please [open an issue](https://github.com/zerokhong1/blog/issues) or email me. I'll fix the post and credit you.
